items.title: Matt Shumer built a GTA-style browser game in 3 days with Fable
items.takeaway: He says 16 RTX PRO 6000 GPUs via Higgsfield powered an in-browser open-world game on a cloud computer.
items.soWhat: If the claim holds, game-scale builds take days of rented GPUs, not studio years.

items.title: Aravind Srinivas: a chief-of-staff teammate can orchestrate the others
items.takeaway: He says to onboard AI teammates for roles you feel bottlenecked on, then orchestrate them yourself or via a chief of staff teammate.
items.soWhat: Start AI teammates where your team is bottlenecked, then add one to coordinate them.
